 The Role 
 

 As a full stack engineer, you will contribute to product vision, develop algorithms and systems to provide deep insights to data, and automation's to enhance the user experience. You're competent with technical operations and can implement, maintain, and troubleshoot the servers, databases, networks, and other systems required to keep everything running. 
 

 Skills Required 
 

 Elastic Search, Ruby, Javascript, Backbone, MySQL, and Java, Go, Apache Spark, Kafka 
 

 Strong architecture skills - You are able to quickly comprehend our existing architecture and determine how it should evolve to support new products and features at scale 
 

 You know how cloud companies operate and have real experience implementing the technologies that you champion. You've seen scale and have managed it successfully. You're familiar with engineering processes and can mitigate roadblocks 
 

 Leadership experience - You are confident, a standout, and your voice is heard. People gravitate to you, follow you, and learn from you
